mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT D.start_time, D.cstmr_name, D.cstmr_id, D.ty_cd, D.staff_name, D.saleId, D.result, D.dlvry_cnt FROM ( SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT((select max(start_time) from sale_job_off where sale_id = S.sale_id),'%y-%m-%d(%a) %H:%i' ) AS CHAR(20) ) start_time , (select cstmr_name from cstmr where cstmr_id=S.cstmr_id) cstmr_name , cstmr_id , S.result , (select count(*) from salePrdct_off where sale_id=S.sale_id and dlvry=1) dlvry_cnt , CASE J.ty_cd WHEN '01200001' THEN '선택' WHEN '01200002' THEN '검안' WHEN '01200003' THEN '조립' WHEN '01200004' THEN '결제' WHEN '01200005' THEN '전달' END AS ty_cd ,(select staff_name from staff where staff_id = J.staff_id) staff_name ,(select distinct(sale_id) from sale_off where sale_id = J.sale_id ORDER BY sale_id DESC)saleId FROM sale_job_off J INNER JOIN sale_off S ON J.sale_id = S.sale_id and S.result != '11111' and S.shop_id=#{shopId} GROUP BY J.start_time DESC) D GROUP BY D.start_time DESC , D.cstmr_id DESC
